{{dablink|For other uses of the word "Jarra," see [[Jarra]].}}
'''Jarra''' is a village in [[Ghealdan]] just north of the border with [[Amadicia]].

== Events ==
[[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] hear stories of many weddings, [[Whitecloaks]] losing their minds and casting off their previous convictions, as well as learn of [[Noam]], a fellow [[wolfbrother]] who has succumbed to his more animal instincts; while trying to track [[Rand]].{{ref/book|3|8}} The group then confirm that Rand has become a more powerful ''[[ta'veren]]'' than [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]] himself.
